newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks drop at noon as blue chips tumble.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks drop at noon as blue chips tumble.

text.p: Pakistan stocks, which had opened higher, sagged at noon on Tuesday as blue chips tumbled on settlement day, dealers said.

"Foreign funds and institutions that sparked last month's rally are on the sidelines and weak holders are squaring their positions today," one dealer said. "The index will slip further as there is little support from major players."
The index fell 21.87 points, or 1.16 percent, to 1,865.77 at noon. Losers led gainers 179 to 18. PTCL fell 0.30 rupees to 36.90 and Dewan Salman Fibre 1.95 to 40.80.
